Appreciate the clarity. Quick answers up front:
- Transactional (sales team) flexibility: up to a 15% one-time reduction on the pilot package (applies only to Q3 committed tokens) without exec signoff.
- Anything beyond 15%, or a multi-quarter guaranteed rate floor, requires VP/CFO approval.
- Delivery-assurance credits tied to SLO (e.g., per-minute missed coverage during validation) are treated as a commercial concession and typically require Finance (Karthik) sign-off unless the exposure is limited to a small capped credit.

I'm looping in Marissa (head of commercial) and Karthik (finance) to confirm; Priyom from sales ops will attach a pricing worksheet and a suggested credit structure for your pilot.

I'll propose a one-time 15% pilot concession plus a capped delivery-assurance credit equivalent to 10% of the pilot package if the validation window sees sustained SLA misses (>10% of minutes below RT threshold). That keeps exposure contained while showing good faith.

Proposed next steps:
1) Priyom to attach revised pricing + MA schedule for your review (attached).
2) If LumenBio accepts, Marissa + Karthik will sign off on any additional concession beyond 15%.
3) We draft a short addendum to the SOW that defines the validation window and SLA credit mechanism.

If that looks reasonable I can fast-track an exec memo for approval.

Thanks —
